args.prompt: [Look: 1960s Japanese giant-monster film, live action, miniatures, Eastmancolor.] [Setting: a miniature 1960s harbor city at night, searchlights.] [Cast: GORUMBA (rubber-suit sea monster, yellow dorsal fins); CAPTAIN MIYAKE (navy uniform, binoculars).] Single shot: low wide shot, 25mm, static camera, one continuous 10 s take. Everyone looks at each other and the props in front of them, never into the lens. At 1 s, GORUMBA rises out of the harbor, water sheeting off its fins. At 4 s, GORUMBA swats a searchlight tower and it topples into the bay. At 7 s, CAPTAIN MIYAKE speaks [shouting over sirens: "It came back for the lighthouse."]. Motion carries on through the last half second. [Adults only, no kids. Invented characters; a named real person becomes only their moves and attitude, never their likeness. No gore; bloodstains on clothing are fine, no blood draining out. Nobody looks into the camera.]
